models.title: MARIO tutorials
models.summary: Focused examples for importing databases, adding sectors and calculating environmental footprints.

readiness.notes: The examples cover several MARIO versions. The GTAP notebooks still refer to historical development branches; check compatibility before running.

what_to_learn: Choose a focused example for a particular modelling task.
Move from a pymrio database to MARIO, work with GTAP, or compare BONSAI GHG footprints.

data.name: Example-specific database inputs
data.notes: Requirements differ by example. BONSAI and GTAP examples require the corresponding source data and access.

models.title: MARIO crash course
models.summary: A hands-on course from input-output foundations to real databases, new sectors and scenarios.

readiness.notes: The repository provides a uv environment and setup guide. Its README reports that Foundations was executed; this catalog has not independently rerun the course.

what_to_learn: Follow the three notebooks in order: foundations, EXIOBASE, and sectors and scenarios.
Use the additional SUT exercise and the recordings of the 2026 course.

data.name: Built-in MARIO test tables
data.notes: Foundations uses built-in test tables. The later notebooks require local EXIOBASE data.

models.title: MRIO sector disaggregation
models.summary: Split a cement sector from a small, two-region GTAP-based input-output table.

readiness.notes: The notebook needs an update before running: three cells contain incomplete path assignments, and its instructions refer to the historical dev_gtap_VA branch.

what_to_learn: Represent a new sector with an inventory workbook.
Inspect the disaggregation workflow on a small EU27 / Rest of World example.

data.name: Example database and inventory workbooks
data.notes: GTAP12_example_db.xlsx and Inventory_example.xlsx are included in the source repository.

models.title: Electricity carbon footprint
models.summary: Calculate and compare electricity GHG intensities and life-cycle footprints across input-output databases.

readiness.notes: The main pipeline requires local source databases and a MARIO version with calc_ghg. The linked blogpost revision contains later analysis and documentation updates; distinguish it from the main pipeline.

what_to_learn: Compare electricity footprints across databases and countries.
Inspect monetary-to-physical conversion and differences in system boundaries.

publications.title: Carbon intensity of electricity: a systematic methodological and quantitative review

data.name: Source databases and comparison inputs
data.notes: The source README describes local input paths and source-specific access requirements. A common unit does not make all system boundaries equivalent.

models.title: Solar PV hybrid LCA
models.summary: Embed the photovoltaic supply chain in a hybrid input-output model and assess EU reshoring scenarios.

readiness.notes: The source provides environment files, headless drivers and a baseline comparison. A rebuild from the linked database is an adaptation of the original base; check the declared reference and tolerances before claiming paper reproduction.

what_to_learn: Add an explicit PV supply chain to a hybrid supply-use model.
Compare reshoring scenarios, environmental and socio-economic outcomes, and sensitivity assumptions.

publications.title: Environmental and socio-economic implications of solar photovoltaic reshoring under the EU Net Zero Industry Act: a hybrid input-output assessment

data.name: Base hybrid-units database
data.notes: Download the base files separately and configure their location as described in the source README.

models.title: FULFILL sufficiency scenarios
models.summary: Assess environmental and socio-economic effects of household sufficiency measures in a decarbonising Europe.

readiness.notes: The source provides three sequential notebooks and a Conda environment. The full scenario sweep is substantial; no scenario has been rerun as part of this catalog review.

what_to_learn: Build the background database and scenario-specific shock files.
Trace sufficiency measures through emissions, value added and employment.

publications.title: The role of sufficiency measures in a decarbonizing Europe
Impact of sufficiency on achieving the EU's 2030 and 2050 greenhouse gas emissions targets

data.name: Study data and results
data.notes: Use the archive linked by the source README together with its notebook instructions.

models.title: GCAM–MARIO steel scenarios
models.summary: Explore steel and electricity mixes, trade and embodied emissions with MARIO and GCAM scenario inputs.

readiness.notes: The source contains MARIO code and GCAM steel and electricity inputs, but has no README or environment. Its association with the linked paper is a catalog candidate awaiting confirmation; the end-to-end workflow is not verified.

what_to_learn: Inspect how GCAM scenario inputs are translated into steel and electricity mixes.
Study embodied-emission calculations for steel policy scenarios.

publications.title: Linking Global Integrated Assessment and Hybrid Input–Output Models To Support Steel Decarbonization Policies in Europe

data.name: Extended steel database cited by the paper
data.notes: This is the archive cited by the paper. Compatibility with this source revision still needs confirmation.
